crew.overview: With dreams of diving abroad, Tsuneo gets a job assisting Josee, an artist whose imagination takes her far beyond her wheelchair. But when the tide turns against them, they push each other to places they never thought possible, and inspire a love fit for a storybook.
crew.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

crew.overview: Unhappy after his new baby sister displaces him, four-year-old Kun begins meeting people and pets from his family's history in their unique house in order to help him become the big brother he was meant to be.
crew.title: Mirai

crew.overview: Three moments in Takaki's life: his relationship with Akari and their forced separation; his friendship with Kanae, who is secretly in love with him; the demands and disappointments of adulthood, an unhappy life in a cold city.
crew.title: 5 Centimeters per Second

crew.overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.
crew.title: Spirited Away

crew.overview: The film centers on Asuna, a young girl who spends her solitary days listening to the mysterious music emanating from the crystal radio she received from her late father as a memento. One day while walking home she is attacked by a fearsome monster and saved by a mysterious boy named Shun. However, Shun disappears and Asuna embarks on a journey of adventure to the land of Agartha with her teacher Mr. Morisaki to meet a Shun again. Through her journey she comes to know the cruelty and beauty of the world, as well as loss.
crew.title: Children Who Chase Lost Voices

details.biography: Masaru Ooshiro (大城 勝, Ōshiro Masaru) is a Japanese animator and character designer. Masaru was one of the core figures in the World Masterpiece Theater series in the 1990s, and was the character designer on Remi, Nobody's Girl. Since the 2000s, he has often been involved in children's animation, and frequently participates in the movie versions of Doraemon and Shin-chan. Animator Tsutomu Ooshiro (大城 勉, Ōshiro Tsutomu) is his younger brother.
details.name: Masaru Ohshiro
